name: Coaster train
notes: Origin at the centre of the lead car, rail top at y = 0, forward +Z, up +Y, cars trail toward -Z. Joints wheels, bars, pitch, bank. Original design, no brand marks.
parts: three lofted open-cockpit car shells with rounded noses
four leather seats per car in two rows
two bogies per car with running, side and up-stop wheels
two headlight lenses on the lead car
style: amusement park steel coaster, red clearcoat paint and chrome
summary: Three-car roller coaster train: red clearcoat lofted car shells, leather seats, chrome lap bars, steel bogies with running, side and up-stop wheels, headlights, joints wheels, bars, pitch, bank.
